effects.printed_clause: Target 5 Spell/Trap Cards in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation targets exactly five eligible Spell/Traps. Resolution requires all five to remain related, returns them, then verifies that all five reached the Deck or Extra Deck before shuffling as needed and drawing two.

official_references.matched_structure: Checks that all five targeted cards were successfully returned before the subsequent draw.

effects.issue: Fixed: the draw now requires all five operated cards to be in the Deck or Extra Deck, rather than succeeding when only one returned.

effects.printed_clause: You cannot activate monster effects the turn you use this effect.
effects.lua_implementation: A custom activity counter prevents activation after an earlier monster effect, and an oath player effect blocks monster-effect activations through the End Phase after this card is used.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a full-turn activity check together with an oath restriction registered through the End Phase.
